column1: # X4 Pro companion fork layout (16 MB flash). Stock partitions.csv gives each OTA
# slot 0x640000 (6.25 MiB); the stock x4pro app already fills 82% of that and
# NimBLE + companion code do not fit reliably. Both OTA slots are grown equally to
# 0x7C0000 (7.75 MiB) because the OTA paths require two slots of the same size:
# network/OtaBootSwitch.cpp derives the boot slot as (ota_seq - 1) % 2
# SdFirmwareUpdateActivity validates the image against
# esp_ota_get_next_update_partition()->size. nvs/otadata/coredump keep their
# stock offsets and sizes. spiffs is never mounted by the firmware (all state is
# on SD under /.crosspoint) so it shrinks to a 384 KiB placeholder that keeps the
# subtype present. Changing the table moves app1
